## Installation

This project uses [`uv`](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv) and [`just`](https://github.com/casey/just) per the TerraEye S&I convention.

```bash
just setup
```

This installs dependencies via `uv sync`, sets up pre-commit hooks, and copies `.env-example` to `.env`.
